response.overview: How do I add passengers to my MSC cruise?To add a passenger to an existing MSC cruise booking, ☎︎+1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK) you must call MSC Customer Service directly or contact your travel advisor, ☎︎+1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK) as this cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest. Yes, you can add a person to an existing MSC cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ ☎︎+1-877-619-8065 (US) or ☎︎ +1-877-619-8065 (UK) or reaching out to your travel agent.
